# tee

Published version: `cli/tee@0.2.5`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Copy stdin to files and stdout for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/tee@0.2.5 [-ap] [--output-error[=MODE]] [FILE...]
```

## Supported scope

Write each input byte to stdout and every file operand. Select append and output-error behavior explicitly.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-a` / `--append` | none | Append instead of truncating files. |
| `--output-error` | required | Modes: warn, warn-nopipe, exit, exit-nopipe; bare flag selects warn-nopipe. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `-p` | none | Modes: warn, warn-nopipe, exit, exit-nopipe; bare flag selects warn-nopipe. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Default broken-pipe handling reports unsupported capability with status 2 instead of raising SIGPIPE. Use -p or an explicit error mode.

## Examples

```sh
printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/tee@0.2.5 output.txt
moonx cli/tee@0.2.5 -a output.txt < extra.txt
```
